Class CacheProxyFactoryBean

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.aop.framework.ProxyConfig
org.springframework.aop.framework.AbstractSingletonProxyFactoryBean
org.springframework.cache.interceptor.CacheProxyFactoryBean
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Aware, BeanClassLoaderAware, BeanFactoryAware, FactoryBean<Object>, InitializingBean, SmartInitializingSingleton
public class CacheProxyFactoryBean extends AbstractSingletonProxyFactoryBean implements BeanFactoryAware, SmartInitializingSingleton
Proxy factory bean for simplified declarative caching handling. This is a convenient alternative to a standard AOP ProxyFactoryBean with a separate CacheInterceptor definition.

该类旨在促进声明式缓存划分：即用缓存代理包装单例目标对象，并代理该目标实现的所有接口。主要用于第三方框架集成。用户应优先使用 cache: XML 命名空间中的@Cacheable注解。有关更多信息，请参阅 Spring 参考文档中的基于注解的声明式缓存部分。

Since:
3.1
Author:
Costin Leau，Juergen Hoeller

    • afterSingletonsInstantiated

      public void afterSingletonsInstantiated()
      描述从接口复制：SmartInitializingSingleton
      Invoked right at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase, with a guarantee that all regular singleton beans have been created already. ListableBeanFactory.getBeansOfType(Class) calls within this method won't trigger accidental side effects during bootstrap.

      注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

      Specified by:
      `afterSingletonsInstantiated` 接口 `SmartInitializingSingleton` 中

    • createMainInterceptor

      protected Object createMainInterceptor()
      描述从类复制：AbstractSingletonProxyFactoryBean
      Create the "main" interceptor for this proxy factory bean. Typically an Advisor, but can also be any type of Advice.

      前置拦截器将在本拦截器之前应用，后置拦截器将在本拦截器之后应用。
